notes.title: Increase the function prompted below the screen
notes.notes:
This update adds the prompt function below the screen, the game will be easier to use. If you have not clicked "I have arrived" in the store, the bottom of the screen will prompt "I have not arrived at the store"; if you have not clicked "I have picked up the meal" in front of the cashier, the bottom of the screen will prompt "Need to pick up the meal before the cashier"; if you do not click "Delivered" at the customer's door, the bottom of the screen will prompt "Need to be delivered at the customer's door";

notes.title: Rush Mode Has Been Launched
notes.notes: The rush mode has been launched. Send 10 orders, if you deliver all on time, you will get more rewards. After completion, you can check how long it took, the total experience gained and the total number of gold coins earned. Unlock after player level 3.

notes.title: Update summary
notes.notes:
Many flowers and trees have been added, turning the grove into a park.
     A motorcycle was added. This motorcycle does not need to be purchased. It was available at the beginning, and then another motorcycle with higher performance was added, which is faster. Players can use the gold coins earned in the game to buy.
     In the previous version, the motorcycle was easy to fall down, but it is now much more stable after modification.
     New gameplay will be introduced later, and it is still being designed and tested to make this gameplay more fun.
